1. [Partial] Check tire pressure to ensure it is not running too high.

_Procedure reported by [t1774]._

## Tips & gotchas

- Run 30 lbs of air for larger tires (like 33s) instead of the standard higher pressure. [t1774]
- Use a chalk test: draw a line across the tire with driveway chalk, roll it on the ground several times. If chalk remains on outside lugs after rolling, reduce air pressure. [t1774]
